params.source:
# HALO v3 — one upper toroidal loop: proof-spin stress (CalculiX static) and natural frequencies (modal)
# Loop geometry = halo_v3.lld (NACA 0012, 24 mm chord, tilt 20°, root on the bell at r = 31 mm).
# Material: CFRP skins (2 x 0.1 mm, ±15° to the loop path) on Rohacell 71, HOMOGENISED to an equivalent isotropic
# solid with the same bending stiffness (E_eq = E_skin * (1 - (1 - 2 t / h)^3) = 60 GPa * 0.35 ≈ 21 GPa); the FE
# surface strain then equals the skin strain, so the allowable is a strain: 4000 µε * E_eq = 84 MPa (company value).
design halo_loop_fea units=mm
param loopChord = 24
param loopTilt = 20
param loopRoot = 31
param loopTipR = 195.14
param loopR = (loopTipR - loopRoot)/2 - loopChord/2
param loopC = (loopTipR + loopRoot)/2
# proof spin: 1.2 x the peak rotor speed at flight-test mass (1931 rpm, analysis/sizing_v3_flight_mass.json) = 2320 rpm
param omega = 242.9
param accR = omega*omega*loopTipR          # centrifugal, taken at the TIP radius for the whole loop (conservative)
param accZ = 185000                        # 2 x hover thrust / 3 loops / loop mass (1.74 N / 9.4 g), mm/s²
param accT = -194000                       # peak drag torque 0.208 N·m per loop at r 114 mm, mm/s²

draw_naca_airfoil s1 naca="0012" chord=loopChord position=[loopR-loopChord/2, 0, 0] pointsPerSide=24
revolve_profile loopBody profileIds=[s1] axis="z" segments=64 position=[loopC, 0, 0] rotation=[loopTilt*pi/180, 0, 0]
# root socket (7075 lug on the bell, halo_v3.lld) captures the root section out to r = 39.5; modelled fused, its flat
# inboard face (r = 30.5, the bell bore) is the clamp. (A face + intersectPlane clamp is NOT honoured by fea_mesh: it
# fixes the whole face, so the socket is geometry here.)
add_box socket size=[9, 8, 8] position=[35, 0, 0]
boolean loop op=union a=loopBody b=socket
create_material _ name=loop_sandwich_eq density=0.45 densityUnit=g/cm^3
add_material_model _ material=loop_sandwich_eq id=elastic model={"kind":"elastic_isotropic","E":{"value":21,"unit":"GPa"},"nu":{"value":0.3,"unit":"1"}} validity=[{"variable":"T","unit":"degC","data":[-20,60]}] basis=company source.citation="HALO homogenised sandwich: E_skin 60 GPa (T700 ±15°, typical) x bending-stiffness ratio 0.35 (t 0.2 mm, h 2.9 mm)"
define_constitutive_set _ material=loop_sandwich_eq set.id=linear set.elastic=elastic makeDefault=true
set_material_property _ material=loop_sandwich_eq property=Ftu value=84 unit=MPa basis=company source.citation="4000 microstrain CFRP design strain x E_eq 21 GPa (HALO strain allowable)"
set_material_property _ material=loop_sandwich_eq property=Fty value=84 unit=MPa basis=company source.citation="4000 microstrain CFRP design strain x E_eq 21 GPa (HALO strain allowable)"
assign_material _ materialName=loop_sandwich_eq entityIds=[loop]
set_part_grounded _ ids=[loop] grounded=true

# --- static: proof spin + peak thrust + peak drag; the root is clamped at r = 39 mm, the outer end of the 7075
#     socket face on the bell; the socket captures the whole root section (the TE is the innermost point)
create_analysis spin name="Loop proof spin 2320 rpm" analysisType=static
set_part_idealization _ analysisId=spin entityId=loop idealization=solid
set_mesh_controls _ analysisId=spin globalSize=2.5 order=2
add_fea_constraint root analysisId=spin name=bell_root kind=fixed target.entityId=loop target.facesNear=[[30.5,0,0]]
add_fea_load spinload analysisId=spin name=spin_thrust_drag kind=gravity vector=[accR, accT, accZ]

# --- modal: first natural frequencies, root clamped (no spin stiffening: conservative)
create_analysis modes name="Loop modes" analysisType=modal modes=4
set_part_idealization _ analysisId=modes entityId=loop idealization=solid
set_mesh_controls _ analysisId=modes globalSize=2.5 order=2
add_fea_constraint root2 analysisId=modes name=bell_root kind=fixed target.entityId=loop target.facesNear=[[30.5,0,0]]

check check_analysis analysisId=spin path=items.0.code expect == "FEA_MESH_MISSING"   # set-up complete; fea_mesh + fea_solve run on the host (Gmsh + CalculiX)

provenance.citation: HALO homogenised sandwich: E_skin 60 GPa (T700 ±15°, typical) x bending-stiffness ratio 0.35 (t 0.2 mm, h 2.9 mm)
4000 microstrain CFRP design strain x E_eq 21 GPa (HALO strain allowable)
